details:
AstroVibe – Climate-Smart Crop Rotation Tool

AstroVibe is a bilingual decision-support tool designed to help farmers make smarter agricultural decisions in the face of climate change. It helps farmers select sustainable crop rotations that protect soil health, conserve water, and improve agricultural resilience under changing environmental conditions.

How Does It Work?

Farmers enter their field information and agricultural priorities, then adjust climate scenarios such as rising temperatures, changing rainfall patterns, and reduced irrigation availability. AstroVibe analyzes the selected conditions and ranks suitable crop rotations based on their performance.

The platform also demonstrates how planting dates may shift, estimates changes in soil organic matter, tests selected rotations under hot and dry conditions, and explains why certain crops may be excluded.

Benefits and Intended Impact

AstroVibe aims to:

  • Support sustainable crop rotation decisions.
  • Help farmers use limited irrigation water more efficiently.
  • Protect and improve long-term soil health.
  • Prepare farmers for changing climate conditions.
  • Reduce uncertainty when selecting crops and planting dates.
  • Make climate information more accessible through a bilingual experience.

Tools and Technologies

The project integrates climate information from NASA POWER. It also includes a Python script that allows users to retrieve location-specific climate data for individual fields. The retrieved data can then be used in the platform for more locally relevant analysis.

The project combines interactive climate scenarios, agricultural decision-support logic, and data visualization to make complex environmental information easier to understand.

Creativity and Innovation

What makes AstroVibe different is that it does not simply recommend crops based on current conditions. It allows farmers to explore possible future climate scenarios and understand how their decisions may perform under different environmental challenges.

It combines crop rotation ranking, planting date adjustments, soil organic matter estimation, and hot-and-dry-year stress testing in one interactive tool. It also explains why certain crops are excluded, making its recommendations easier to understand.

Factors Considered

The project considers temperature changes, rainfall variability, irrigation availability, soil health, soil organic matter, planting windows, crop suitability, and farmers' individual priorities.

The built-in regional datasets are approximate and intended for exploration. For field-specific analysis, users can retrieve actual climate data through the provided NASA POWER script.

AstroVibe's mission is to turn climate data into practical agricultural decisions and help build a more sustainable and climate-resilient future for farming.
